title: 第 12 课 · 信号发生器和示波器
summary: 幅度、峰峰值、有效值、偏置、频率和周期；探头的针尖和接地夹；时间/格、伏/格；以及信号发生器 50 Ω 的输出电阻。
concepts: amplitude / Vpp / RMS 幅度 / 峰峰值 / 有效值
description: 先看「拆开看」里的 **信号发生器** 和 **示波器**（左侧会自动打开）：50 Ω 内阻、幅度 / 偏置，伏/格和时间/格。
**这一课学什么**：第 3、4 期的实验都用信号发生器产生波形、用示波器看波形。这一课先只看信号发生器自己的输出。
**1. 信号发生器的设定**（单击它，在“属性”里改）
| 设定 | 意思 | 换算 |
| 波形 | 正弦 / 方波 / 三角波 | — |
| 幅度（峰值） | 最高点离中心线的距离 | 峰峰值 Vpp = 2 × 幅度；正弦的有效值 RMS = 幅度 / √2 |
| 直流偏置（offset） | 把整个波形上下平移 | 平均值 = 偏置 |
| 频率 f | 每秒几个周期 | 周期 T = 1 / f |
例：幅度 2 V 的正弦 → Vpp = 4 V，RMS = 2 / √2 ≈ 1.41 V；f = 500 Hz → T = 2 ms。
**2. 示波器探头**
| 部分 | 接到 |
| 针尖（tip） | 要看的点 |
| 接地夹（ground clip） | **必须**夹在电路的 GND 上 |
屏幕显示的是“针尖 − 接地夹”的电压随时间的变化。
| 量 | 怎么读 |
| 周期 T | 一个周期占几格（横向）× 时间/格（time/div） |
| 峰峰值 Vpp | 波峰到波谷占几格（纵向）× 伏/格（V/div） |
| 其他 | 屏幕下面直接列出 Vpp、频率等读数；旋钮在“自动”时示波器自己挑格子 |
信号发生器内部 = 理想波形源串联 50 Ω。不接负载时输出就是设定值；接上负载 R，输出被 50 Ω 和 R 分压：
- **输出幅度 = 设定幅度 × R / (50 + R)**
接上 50 Ω 负载以后，用上面的公式算峰峰值和有效值。
**仿真和真实仪器**：很多真实信号发生器默认按“接 50 Ω 负载”显示幅度——接到高阻电路上实际幅度是显示值的 2 倍，要把输出设成 High-Z 显示才对。这里的设定值是不接负载时的幅度。真实示波器探头有 1 MΩ（×1）或 10 MΩ（×10）输入电阻和十几 pF 电容，会轻微影响高阻、高频电路；这里的探头是理想的。真实示波器所有接地夹都连在一起、连到大地。
compare:
**对比**：设定 1 V 幅度（2 Vpp），接 50 Ω 负载后分压 50 / (50 + 50) = 1/2：
- 峰峰值 **1.0 Vpp**；有效值 = 0.5 / √2 ≈ **0.354 V**；
- 频率 1 kHz，周期 **1 ms**（时间/格 100 µs 时正好 10 格）；
- 偏置 +1 V 时，直流部分也被 50 Ω 分掉一半：平均值 **0.5 V**。

en.title: Lesson 12 · Function generator and oscilloscope
en.summary: Amplitude, peak-to-peak, RMS, offset, frequency and period; the probe tip and ground clip; time/div and volts/div; and the generator's 50 Ω output resistance.
description: Look at the **Function generator** and **Oscilloscope** teardowns first (they open on the left): the 50 Ω output, amplitude / offset, V/div and time/div.
**What you learn**: the labs of phases 3 and 4 make waveforms with a function generator and watch them on an oscilloscope. This lesson looks at the generator's own output only.
**1. Generator settings** (click it and change them in Properties)
| Setting | Meaning | Conversion |
| waveform | sine / square / triangle | — |
| amplitude (peak) | distance from the centre line to the top | peak-to-peak Vpp = 2 × amplitude; for a sine RMS = amplitude / √2 |
| DC offset | shifts the whole waveform up or down | average = offset |
| frequency f | cycles per second | period T = 1 / f |
Example: a 2 V-amplitude sine → Vpp = 4 V, RMS = 2 / √2 ≈ 1.41 V; f = 500 Hz → T = 2 ms.
**2. Scope probe**
| Part | Goes to |
| tip | the point you want to see |
| ground clip | **must** be on the circuit's GND |
The screen shows tip − ground clip over time.
**3. Reading the screen**
| Quantity | How to read it |
| period T | divisions per cycle (horizontally) × time/div |
| peak-to-peak Vpp | divisions from peak to trough (vertically) × V/div |
| others | Vpp, frequency etc. are listed under the screen; with the knobs on Auto the scope picks the scales |
**4. The 50 Ω output resistance**
Inside, the generator is an ideal source in series with 50 Ω. With no load the output equals the setting; with a load R, 50 Ω and R form a divider:
- **output amplitude = set amplitude × R / (50 + R)**
- Example: with R = 1 kΩ only 1000 / 1050 ≈ 95 % of the setting is left.
**5. Predict first**
With a 50 Ω load connected, use that formula for the peak-to-peak and RMS values.

**Simulated vs real instruments**: many real generators display the amplitude assuming a 50 Ω load — into a high-impedance circuit the real amplitude is twice the display, unless you set the output to High-Z. Here the setting is the unloaded amplitude. A real scope probe has 1 MΩ (×1) or 10 MΩ (×10) input resistance and a dozen or so pF, which slightly affects high-impedance, high-frequency circuits; these probes are ideal. On a real scope all ground clips are tied together and to earth.
steps: Pick "Function generator", click a5 (red clip, signal +), then tn5 (black clip, COM). There is no other supply on the board, so its black clip is GND.
Look at Properties: sine, 1 kHz, amplitude 1 V (2 Vpp), offset 0 V. Keep these settings.
Pick "Scope probe", click c5 (tip) then tn8 (ground clip, on GND). It goes to CH1 and the scope window appears: a sine, 2 Vpp.

The knobs under the scope screen are on AUTO now. Use − / + to set **time/div** to 100 µs and **CH1 V/div** to 1 V. Count: one period is 10 divisions (10 × 100 µs = 1 ms), peak to trough 2 divisions (2 × 1 V = 2 Vpp).
Click the generator and set the **offset** to +1 V: the whole trace moves up 1 division (1 V/div); the shape doesn't change.
Set the offset back to 0 V.
Add a load: resistor from b5 to tn12, and type 50 as a custom value in Properties. The trace is now half as tall — the generator's own 50 Ω and the load divide the voltage.
Press "Check my circuit" and answer from the readouts under the scope screen (the last question needs the offset at +1 V first).
hints: Peak-to-peak = 2 × amplitude; RMS = peak / √2; period = 1 / frequency.
With a load, treat the generator as an ideal source plus 50 Ω, forming a divider with the load.
50 Ω against 50 Ω divides by exactly two, for the AC and the DC (offset) alike.
tests: With the load the amplitude drops

measurements.ask: CH1 peak-to-peak Vpp (50 Ω load connected, amplitude set to 1 V)
measurements.explain: 2 Vpp × 50 / (50 + 50) = 1 Vpp: the generator's own 50 Ω and the load form a divider.
Same as the setting: a load changes the amplitude, not the frequency.

measurements.ask: Period T = 1 / f (count it: how many divisions is one period at 100 µs/div?)

measurements.explain: Sine: RMS = peak / √2 = 0.5 / 1.414 ≈ 0.354 V. A multimeter's AC range shows this value.

measurements.ask: Set the offset to +1 V: CH1 average
measurements.explain: The offset is DC and is halved by the same 50 Ω / 50 Ω divider: 0.5 V.

measurements.ask: CH1 的峰峰值 Vpp（接着 50 Ω 负载，设定幅度 1 V）
measurements.explain: 2 Vpp × 50 / (50 + 50) = 1 Vpp：信号发生器自己的 50 Ω 和负载分压。
和设定一样：负载只改变幅度，不改变频率。

measurements.ask: 周期 T = 1 / f（数一数：时间/格 100 µs 时一个周期占几格？）
CH1 的有效值 RMS（同一状态）
measurements.explain: 正弦波：有效值 = 峰值 / √2 = 0.5 / 1.414 ≈ 0.354 V。万用表交流档读到的就是它。

measurements.ask: 把偏置调到 +1 V：CH1 的平均值
measurements.explain: 偏置是直流，同样被 50 Ω 和 50 Ω 分掉一半：0.5 V。

steps.text: 选“信号发生器”，单击 a5（红夹子，信号 +），再单击 tn5（黑夹子，COM）。板上没有别的电源，所以它的黑夹子就是 GND。
看“属性”：正弦波、1 kHz、幅度 1 V（2 Vpp）、偏置 0 V，就用这个设定。
选“示波器探头”，单击 c5（针尖），再单击 tn8（接地夹，夹在 GND 上）。它自动接 CH1，示波器窗口出现：正弦波，Vpp 2 V。
示波器窗口下面的旋钮现在是 AUTO。用 − / + 把**时间/格**调到 100 µs，**CH1 伏/格**调到 1 V。数一数：一个周期 10 格（10 × 100 µs = 1 ms），波峰到波谷 2 格（2 × 1 V = 2 Vpp）。
单击信号发生器，把**偏置**调到 +1 V：整条波形往上移 1 格（1 V/格），形状不变。
接一个负载：电阻单击 b5 和 tn12，阻值在“属性”里输入 50（自定义）。波形只剩一半高——信号发生器自己的 50 Ω 和负载分压了。
点“检查我的电路”，读示波器屏幕下面的读数完成测量题（最后一题要先把偏置调到 +1 V）。

hints: 峰峰值 = 2 × 幅度；有效值 = 峰值 / √2；周期 = 1 / 频率。
接上负载以后，把信号发生器看成“理想源 + 50 Ω”，和负载组成一个分压器。
50 Ω 对 50 Ω 正好分一半：交流和直流（偏置）都一样。
